mapper.select: select sba.user_name,su.description,sba.role_code,srvl.role_name,sba.button_authority_id from SYS_BUTTON_AUTHORITY sba left join sys_role_b srvl on sba.role_code = srvl.role_code left join sys_user su on sba.user_name = su.user_name where sba.button_authority_id = #{buttonAuthorityId}

SELECT ( SELECT sr.role_id FROM sys_role_b sr WHERE sr.role_code = t.role_code ) role_id, ( SELECT su.user_id FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_name = t.user_name ) user_id, d.function_code, d.url, d.button_filter FROM sys_button_authority t, sys_button_authority_detail d WHERE t.button_authority_id = d.button_authority_id AND sysdate BETWEEN t.start_date AND ifnull ( t.end_date, sysdate ) AND sysdate BETWEEN d.start_date AND ifnull ( d.end_date, sysdate )
